wanted_details.heading: Sanctions-designation details
wanted_details.status: Designated by OFAC on July 8, 2025 under Executive Order 13694 as amended, program tag CYBER4, as a malicious cyber actor associated with the Reconnaissance General Bureau hacking group Andariel

details.label: Location
details.value: Changbailu No. 55, Yanji, Jilin 133000, China; North Korea

wanted_details.caution: Song is a DPRK-based cyber actor who used foreign-hired IT workers to seek remote employment with U.S. companies and planned to split income with them. In 2022 and 2023, Song used U.S. persons’ information, including names, social security numbers, and addresses to create aliases for the hired foreign workers. The workers then used the accounts to pose as U.S. persons looking for remote jobs with U.S. companies.

sources.title: Recent Actions, July 8, 2025: Cyber-related and North Korea Designations (Song Kum Hyok, Gayk Asatryan, Asatryan LLC, Fortuna LLC, Korea Songkwang Trading, Korea Saenal Trading)
sources.publisher: U.S. Department of the Treasury, Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC)

sources.title: Sanctions Imposed on DPRK IT Workers Generating Revenue for the Kim Regime
미국, 북한 해킹조직 안다리엘 소속 해커 '송금혁' 제재 (United States sanctions Song Kum Hyok, a hacker with the North Korean group Andariel)

disclaimer: Song Kum Hyok is profiled here as the DPRK-based facilitator the Treasury says ran an IT-worker scheme from the Andariel side: hiring foreign IT workers, building them aliases from stolen United States identities in 2022 and 2023, and planning to split their remote-work income. OFAC's entry gives an address in Yanji and an email address, which the scraper carries as an indicator.
OFAC prints no Hangul for this name and the entry carries no photograph, so no Korean rendering is published rather than a reconstructed one.

The confidence level of 'confirmed' reflects that this individual is named on OFAC's Specially Designated Nationals list; a sanctions designation is an administrative action by the Treasury and not a criminal charge, and nothing here states that any court has found anything.
